proposal.summary: Reporter observed the desktop client occasionally sending network requests to an unfamiliar address at startup and could not determine whether personal data was included.

AV.quote: sends requests to an address I do not recognize when it starts up

C.quote: I am not a security expert and I could not tell whether any personal data is included

I.quote: I am not a security expert and I could not tell whether any personal data is included

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request from the reporter: (1) the desktop client name and exact version, (2) the unfamiliar destination address (hostname/IP) and any observed request details (URL, headers, timing), and (3) a packet capture or logs showing the request; then analyze the traffic to determine whether any personal data is transmitted and whether the behavior is expected.

evidence_quotes.quote: sends requests to an address I do not recognize when it starts up

evidence_quotes.claim: Reporter could not determine if personal data was included
evidence_quotes.quote: I am not a security expert and I could not tell whether any personal data is included
